# Selection for improved flight performance

## Dry mass of adults

See Methods section for details of experimental set-up.

### Call relevant packages

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(AICcmodavg)
library(lmerTest)
library(effectsize)
library(MuMIn)

theme_set(theme_cowplot())
```

### Import and wrangle data

Imported into a tibble "Mass_data_raw" and processed into "Mass_data"

```{r}
Mass_data_raw <- read_excel("~/Flying_Flies_Phenotyping/Raw_data/DryMassData.xlsx", na = "NA")

# Get dry mass per fly
Mass_data_raw <- Mass_data_raw %>% 
  mutate(DryMassTechnical = `DryMass(10e-4 g)`/BatchSize) %>% 
  drop_na()

Mass_data <- Mass_data_raw %>% group_by(Selection, PopReplicate, Vial, Sex, VialSample) %>% 
  summarise(DryMass = mean(DryMassTechnical)) %>% 
  mutate(PopRep = paste(Selection, PopReplicate, sep = "_")) %>% 
  mutate(VialNest = paste(PopRep, Vial, sep = "_V")) %>% 
  mutate_at(c("Selection", "PopReplicate", "PopRep", "Sex", "VialNest"), factor)
  
```

### Analysis

AIC table using dredge function

```{r}
options(na.action = "na.fail") # required for dredge function

global_model_Mass <- lmer(data = Mass_data, REML = FALSE,
  DryMass ~ Selection * Sex + (1|PopRep))

AIC_res_Mass <- dredge(global_model_Mass)

# view(as.data.frame(AIC_res_Mass))

selected_model_Mass <- lmer(data = Mass_data, REML = TRUE,
  DryMass ~ Selection * Sex + (1|PopRep))

eta_squared(selected_model_Mass)
```

```{r}
                   data = Mass_data, REML = T)

                   data = Mass_data, REML = T)

anova(fit_mass_1)

```

```{r}
fit_mass_1_ML <- lmer(DryMass ~ Selection + (1|PopRepNest) + Sex + (1|PopRepNest:Sex) + Selection:Sex, 
                   data = Mass_data, REML = F)

fit_mass_2_ML <- lmer(DryMass ~ Sex + (1|PopReplicate:Sex), 
                   data = Mass_data, REML = F)

                   data = Mass_data, REML = F)

aictab(cand.set = list(fit_mass_1_ML, fit_mass_2_ML, fit_mass_3_ML))

cohens_f(fit_mass_1)
```

### Plots

```{r}
ggplot(data = Mass_data, aes(x = Selection, y = DryMass)) +
  geom_boxplot(color = 'darkblue') +
  geom_point(aes(shape = PopReplicate), color = 'steelblue1', position = position_jitter(width = 0.1)) +
  facet_grid(~Sex) +
  stat_summary(fun = 'mean', color = 'red', size = 4, shape = '-')
```
